style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard noon sun
motion_rule: she runs left on her own six blurring legs in every beat and the camera runs beside her at her own height, so the packed fur walls tear past behind her in every beat; a coat sleeve or a moth wipes the lens in every beat; she fills half the frame height, chest up from 6.8; new shot size each beat, one clear action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a plump grey clothes moth in a brown mink coat, powdery wings, feathered antennae, round belly, deadpan face
second_characters: ONE lean moth in a green clerk visor chasing her at the lens all clip, waving a bill; A SWARM of moths crossing the lens with a dry flutter in every beat
props: ONE fat folder of bills in her arms; ONE long strip of bills unrolling from it; brown mink coats packed floor to ceiling; blank paper price tags fluttering thick; brass hangers; ONE red-stamped bill in the clerk's grip; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the strip of bills whips behind her from 1.3 on, never parked; the chewed sleeve is her own; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: a narrow wardrobe aisle where fur fills every inch of both walls to the ceiling, hard noon sun cutting through the coats

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty female voice, deadpan, even 4.4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: me-NYA, GLO-zhut, sche-TA, dol-GHI, TAK-zhe, PA-ra, shub, NOR-ki, poch-TI, do-YE-la
audio.pacing: 0.4-4.3 one breath; pause 4.3-4.7; 4.7-6.8 one breath; after 6.8 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her mouth opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: fur rustling all clip, running steps, dry wing flutter, paper riffling, one wet spit at 7.6

timeline.a: she bursts into frame at a full run, the fur walls tearing past the other way
she rips a mouthful of fur off a passing coat without slowing, the coat sweeping across the lens and clearing as torn fur flies back past her
she hurls the folder open at a run and a long strip of bills bursts out and whips across the whole frame
she crashes shoulder first through a hanging coat, the fur bursting apart across the lens as she runs on
she swats a rack of coats and it swings away past the lens, brass hangers clattering loose
she rounds a corner at full run, the strip whipping out long behind her, tags tearing loose off the walls
the clerk moth shoves the red-stamped bill at the lens and is swept aside as she runs past him
she dives through a gap in the fur wall, a solid slab of coats sweeping between her and the lens
she leans out at the lens mid-run, coats and tags tearing past behind her
she runs past one stripped hanger swinging empty, the swarm tearing across the lens after her
chest-up close shot: still running, she rips a strip of fur off her own sleeve with her teeth, coats streaking behind
she spits the wad of fur straight at the lens, face to camera, still running as the fur walls haul past

must_appear: at 2.2 she crashes through a hanging coat and the fur bursts open across the lens; at 6.8 chest-up, she rips fur off her own sleeve with her teeth; at 7.4 she spits the wad at the lens, face to camera
negative_prompt: speech bubble, speech balloon, comic panel, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, latin letters, printed words on props, letterbox, night, a parked camera, a still background, a bare shelf, an empty white wall, a hero sitting, a hero riding, a cart, a conveyor, a rail, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, human hands, speech after 6.8
